image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a printed paper menu. The menu features a beige background with text organized into columns and sections. There are visible headings like 'Dinner Menu', 'Appetizers', and 'Opo Opo'. The text appears to be in English and possibly another language (Chinese characters are faintly visible). There is significant red overlay text or graffiti-like markings on the top right and bottom sections, which look like digital artifacts or intentional overlays rather than part of the physical print. The lighting is somewhat dim and yellowish.
